fields.description: The wire Task.id. Minted on insert for Inbound tasks; never edited.
fields.label: Task ID
State
fields.options:
submitted
working
input-required
completed
canceled
failed
rejected
auth-required
timed-out

fields.description: The remote server's task id (Outbound only).
fields.label: Remote Task ID

fields.description: The approved caller (Inbound only) — who asked.
fields.label: A2A Client

fields.description: The user this task executes as.
fields.label: Principal

fields.description: The local agent that handed this work over (Internal only) — who asked.
fields.label: Delegated By

fields.description: The remote agent this task was delegated to (Outbound only) — who was asked.
fields.label: Remote Agent

fields.description: The local agent doing the work (Inbound) or delegating it (Outbound).
fields.label: Agent Configuration

fields.description: The instance WAITING on this task — the one whose step parked. Distinct from `instance`, which is the instance DOING the work; for a same-site delegation those are two different processes.
fields.label: Caller Instance

fields.description: Spiff task UUID of the parked Service Task in the caller's instance. This is what a resume targets.
fields.label: Caller Workflow Task ID

fields.description: Spiff task UUID of the parked Service Task (Outbound only).
fields.label: Workflow Task ID

fields.description: The human task row this task is waiting on: an aihuman:: row (Inbound) or a2ahuman:: row (Outbound).
fields.label: Pending Human Task

fields.description: One id per top-level request; every delegation in its chain carries it (WI-002008).
fields.label: Task Execution ID

fields.description: How deep this task is nested (A → B → C = 3). Enforced locally against the agent's max_recursion_depth.
fields.label: Delegation Depth

fields.description: Total handoffs in this execution chain. Enforced locally against the agent's max_task_handoffs.
fields.label: Handoff Count

fields.description: Who answers when the remote agent asks a question. Falls back to the instance initiator.
fields.label: Input Assignee

fields.description: Past this moment the delegation is timed out: best-effort remote cancel, then the normal BPMN error path.
fields.label: Deadline

fields.description: Set once the parked step has been handed a resume job. Stops a finished task being woken twice, and stops one that finished between checks being missed.
fields.label: Resume Enqueued

fields.description: Outbound: the remote agreed to call us when this task changes, so polling drops back to a slow reconciliation.
fields.label: Push Registered

fields.description: Outbound: the secret the remote must present on our callback. It is the only gate on that endpoint.
fields.label: Our Callback Token

fields.description: Inbound: where this caller asked to be told about state changes.
fields.label: Caller Callback URL

fields.description: Inbound: the token the caller gave us to present on their callback.
fields.label: Caller Callback Token

fields.description: Inbound: consecutive failed callback attempts. The caller can always fall back to polling.
fields.label: Push Failures
